newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-TENERIFE AND BETIS SIGN NEW COACHES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TENERIFE AND BETIS SIGN NEW COACHES.

text.p: Spanish club Tenerife have signed former Zaragoza coach Victor Fernandez to fill the gap left by the departure of new Real Madrid coach Jupp Heynckes.
Fernandez last enjoyed success in 1995 when he led Zaragoza to victory over Arsenal in the European Cup Winners Cup Final.
In other developments Real Betis announced on Tuesday that veteran first division manager Luis Aragones will take over next season from Lorenzo Serra Ferrer.
Serra Ferrer is known to be looking for a less stressful role and is expected to take over the reserve sides at Barcelona.
Aragones resigned from Valencia earlier this season after taking second place in last season's Spanish championship.
Betis also confirmed that they have signed striker Oli Alvarez from Oviedo for one billion pesetas ($7 million).
The Seville-based side has been looking for a partner for international forward Alfonso Perez for several months.
